provenance.paper_title: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System

evidence.paraphrase: Dual latent perception and thinking memories are synthesized and accessed on demand.

evidence.section: Full paper: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System
evidence.paraphrase: Fixed synthesis modules update latent memory across turns. For L2-VMAS, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of perception and thinking latent units.
Retrieved units are filtered and merged before injection. For L2-VMAS, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of perception and thinking latent units.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (perception and thinking latent units) changes through a trained but frozen update module, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
